tasks.label: cleanup-gradle-locks
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'java.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'org.gradle.launcher.daemon' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-ChildItem 'C:\Users\user\.gradle\caches' -Recurse -Filter *.lock -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'cleaned'

tasks.label: stop-gradle-and-clear-transforms
tasks.command: Set-Location "c:\Users\user\date\date\android"; .\gradlew.bat --stop; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "C:\Users\user\.gradle\caches\8.12\transforms" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "C:\Users\user\.gradle\caches\transforms-*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "stopped-and-cleared"

tasks.label: kill-java-clear-transforms-build
tasks.command: Get-Process java -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "C:\Users\user\.gradle\caches\8.12\transforms" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Location "c:\Users\user\date\date"; flutter build appbundle

tasks.label: full-gradle-8.12-cache-reset-build
tasks.command: Get-Process java -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "C:\Users\user\.gradle\caches\8.12" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Location "c:\Users\user\date\date\android"; .\gradlew.bat --stop; Set-Location "c:\Users\user\date\date"; flutter build appbundle
